sources.excerpt: Equality Equality SOCIALISM Political Theory Socialism refers to a set of political ideas that emerged as a response to the inequalities present in, and reproduced by, the industrial capitalist economy. The main concern of Socialism is how to minimise existing inequality and distribute resources justly. We, therefore, put Part IV into our Constitution containing directive principles of State policy which specify the socialistic goal to be achieved.
